distill_overlap.note: `join` is what a model fitted on the committed corpus (train.jsonl + val.jsonl) has already seen, and is the default the harness drops; `train_only_join` is the smaller set a model fitted on train.jsonl alone has seen. `eval_harness.scoreable()` performs this join for any predictor that declares `trained_on`.

superseded.why: `families_in_distill` counted the corpus's own families (293), not the 106 of this set's families that corpus contains, so the pair read as a join when only its row count was one. The 239/145 pair in the brief is the same two quantities with val.jsonl left out: a correct count of the corpus, and the row count for a predictor fitted on train.jsonl alone. Both row counts are right for their own declaration; neither pair states the intersection. Separately, `data/distill/manifest.json` records 295 families because it counts before its two excluded rows: the committed files hold 293.

duplicates.why: literal punctuation contradicts the slot table

rule: family = one authored frame (all slot-filled variants of one sentence skeleton); a family is assigned to train or test before any utterance is rendered. Selection: slot-bearing frames first, seeded-hash order within groups, t3 round-robin across rival pairs. Balance: greedy largest-first per class-band, ties by seeded hash.
